candidates.summary: TestFrameGridScanLinear skips every page whose 1600-copy render takes under 20ms, so a fast runner checks nothing
candidates.failure_scenario: The `if large < 20*time.Millisecond { continue }` guard drops the ratio check per page; if every page renders under 20ms at 1600 copies the test passes without asserting linearity.
candidates.verify_by: time the three pages at 400 and 1600 copies with the test's own render loop (tests/judge-1001-frame-tag-probe_test.go TestJudgeGridScanTimes) and read whether large >= 20ms
